title: Oozing American Figs Pasta
description: A malty, molten pasta dish that celebrates figs with a creamy pasta-water emulsion, perfect for a festive American dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook 200g spaghetti until al dente, 8-10 minutes.
While pasta cooks, slice 12 figs into quarters and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and add figs, cooking 2 minutes until caramelized.
Add a pinch of red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir for 30 seconds.
Stir in 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp lemon zest, and a handful of chopped basil, cooking for another minute.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water, and add to skillet, tossing to coat.
Pour in 1 cup reserved pasta water to create an emulsion, allowing sauce to thicken for 2 minutes.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup grated parmesan and 50g walnut halves, tossing until cheese melts and nuts are lightly toasted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with remaining basil leaves.
Serve immediately, optionally adding extra parmesan if desired.
